title: WSL environment and Git history
caption: Ubuntu on EAGLE responds to Git, Docker and Compose checks. The initial application commits are visible and the working tree is clean.

title: Healthy Compose services
caption: The application and PostgreSQL containers report healthy. The application is published on loopback port 8090.

title: TaskOps application dashboard
caption: The Compose deployment displays five sample tasks, status counts and a ready backend. Task titles are sample data, not evidence that the named operations were performed.

title: Automated test execution
caption: The isolated Compose test runner reports 46 passed in 0.58 seconds and cleans up its test resources. This timing belongs to this run only.

title: Prometheus metrics endpoint
caption: The application exposes HTTP counters and a database-availability gauge through /metrics.

title: Structured application log sample
caption: Recent application requests appear as JSON records with timestamps, request IDs, routes, status codes and durations.

title: Compose API and health checks
caption: Health, liveness and database readiness succeed. The initial local image reports version 0.1.0 with no embedded build date or Git SHA.

title: Infrastructure preflight
caption: Ansible connectivity, Terraform, existing profiles and Docker resources are checked. The Jenkins root URL returns HTTP 403 in this early check.

title: Terraform initialization and validation
caption: Terraform initializes successfully and validates the infrastructure configuration.

title: Terraform plan
caption: The plan contains one terraform_data resource with requested profile, CPU and memory inputs. The plan is saved for application.

title: Terraform provisions the cluster
caption: The local-exec command starts the dedicated Minikube profile. Terraform reports one resource added.

title: Cluster health and repeat plan
caption: Minikube components are running, the node is Ready and system pods are Running. A second Terraform plan reports no changes to its managed state.

title: Ansible local connectivity
caption: The localhost ping module returns pong.

title: Ansible configures the cluster
caption: The playbook creates development and production namespaces with quotas and limit ranges. The recap shows ok=6, changed=1 and failed=0.

title: Namespace resource policies
caption: Both namespaces and their resource policies are present. The production quota allows 15 pods and sets aggregate CPU and memory budgets.

title: Ansible idempotency
caption: Repeating the playbook reports unchanged resources, ok=6, changed=0 and failed=0.

title: Infrastructure milestone pushed
caption: The Terraform and Ansible implementation is pushed to GitHub as commit 3e2fec3.

title: Images in the Minikube runtime
caption: The initial TaskOps and PostgreSQL images are available inside the cluster runtime.

title: ConfigMap and Secret metadata
caption: The application ConfigMap and three-key database Secret exist. Only key names and byte counts are displayed.

title: PostgreSQL and persistent storage
caption: The database StatefulSet is ready and its 2 GiB ReadWriteOnce claim is Bound. A headless Service exposes PostgreSQL internally.

title: Database privilege separation
caption: PostgreSQL lists a restricted taskops application role and a separate administrative role. The taskops schema belongs to the application role.

title: Application replicas and endpoints
caption: The application has two ready replicas, the database has one, and the Service has two application endpoints.

title: Kubernetes port forwarding
caption: A local port-forward exposes the Kubernetes application on port 8091 and handles incoming connections.

title: TaskOps running on Kubernetes
caption: The browser displays the ready TaskOps dashboard through the Kubernetes port-forward.

title: Kubernetes API checks
caption: The Kubernetes-hosted application responds to health, readiness, version and statistics requests.

title: Baseline workloads
caption: Before scaling, the application is 2/2 ready, the database is 1/1 ready and the persistent claim remains Bound.

title: Scale from two to four replicas
caption: A manual scaling command changes the application from 2/2 to 4/4 ready replicas.

title: Application pod replacement
caption: A selected application pod is deleted. Kubernetes creates a different pod and restores four ready replicas.

title: Return to two replicas
caption: The application is scaled back to two replicas and the rollout completes.

title: Application before the persistence check
caption: The dashboard remains available after the scaling exercise, with the five initial tasks.

title: Create a persistence test record
caption: A Kubernetes Persistence Test task is added, increasing the total to six. This is the record used for the following database pod-recreation check.

title: Recreate the PostgreSQL pod
caption: The database pod is deleted and recreated. The replacement is ready and the same persistent claim remains Bound.

title: Verify data after pod recreation
caption: Readiness reports the database available and statistics still show six tasks after the database pod is recreated.

title: Kubernetes manifests pushed
caption: The deployment and storage manifests are committed and pushed as 9e95297.

title: Jenkins service status
caption: The service status is active. Later screenshots provide the actual pipeline execution evidence.

title: Jenkins directory-permission diagnosis
caption: Java, Buildx and Git respond for the Jenkins user. The Git check fails from the private user directory; E38 shows the successful check from /tmp.

title: Jenkins credentials area
caption: The Jenkins credentials administration page is open during setup. Credential values are not displayed.

title: Jenkins connectivity and workspace access
caption: From /tmp, the Jenkins user can read the repository HEAD, write to its own home directory and invoke Docker Buildx.

title: Security tool versions
caption: Bandit 1.9.4, pip-audit 2.10.1 and Trivy 0.76.2 are available to Jenkins.

title: Bandit threshold result
caption: The -ll -ii scan reports no findings at its selected threshold. The metrics still list five medium-severity, low-confidence findings.

title: Dependency audit result
caption: pip-audit reports no known vulnerabilities for requirements.txt at the time of this scan.

title: Jenkinsfile committed
caption: The automated Jenkins pipeline is committed and pushed as acc1a0c.

title: Jenkins pipeline execution
caption: Jenkins console output records the automated build and test workflow. Additional scan and completion details follow.

title: Trivy report summary
caption: The recorded image scan lists 46 Debian findings and five Python-package findings. Other listed runtime package entries show zero findings in this report.

title: Trivy operating-system findings
caption: The operating-system section records 44 high and two critical package-vulnerability findings. These are reported findings, not remediation evidence.

title: Trivy Python-package findings
caption: The Python section records five high-severity findings. Package provenance and practical exploitability require separate assessment.

title: Jenkins successful completion
caption: The console records image publication and a successful CI run. The configured Trivy stage reports findings without making them a blocking gate.

title: Argo CD installation in progress
caption: Argo CD workloads and Services are created. Several pods are still starting in this early capture; later Healthy and Synced screenshots show completion.

title: Argo CD initial dashboard
caption: The Argo CD dashboard is accessible before the TaskOps Application is added.

title: Argo CD application resources
caption: TaskOps appears Healthy and Synced with its Kubernetes resources displayed in the application graph.

title: Jenkins GitOps integration pushed
caption: The pipeline update that writes the deployment image back to Git is pushed as 475ea41.

title: Jenkins GitOps run
caption: Jenkins console output records the delivery workflow after GitOps integration.

title: GitOps image update observed
caption: The repository contains the generated GitOps deployment commit while the rollout is being checked. E54 captures the completed target image rollout.

title: GitOps rollout verified
caption: Argo CD is Synced and Healthy. The application is running axdy02/taskops:475ea41 and the rollout completes.

title: Monitoring services started
caption: Prometheus and Grafana start as separate Docker Compose services on localhost ports 9090 and 3000.

title: Compose scrape target UP
caption: Prometheus reports its TaskOps Compose endpoint UP.

title: Grafana Prometheus data source
caption: Grafana lists the Prometheus data source used by the dashboard.

title: Grafana application dashboard
caption: The dashboard shows application status, database availability, total HTTP requests and average response time. The readings are a demonstration snapshot.

title: Both Prometheus targets UP
caption: Prometheus reports both the Compose target and Kubernetes NodePort target UP.

title: ELK services and cluster health
caption: Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana are running. The single-node Elasticsearch cluster reports green at this early check.

title: Centralized log count
caption: Elasticsearch contains 115 documents in the TaskOps log index with zero failed shards for the count request.

title: Kibana log inspection
caption: Kibana displays the ingested TaskOps events. Structured HTTP logs coexist with server diagnostics and JSON parse-failure entries.

title: Runtime security controls
caption: The capture shows Secret metadata, a non-root UID of 10001, read-only root filesystem, dropped capabilities, resource quotas and .env ignored by Git.

title: Blue and Green ready
caption: Both environments have two replicas. Blue initially uses f341dbd, Green uses 475ea41, and the main Service initially selects Blue.

title: Traffic switched to Green
caption: The Service selects taskops-green. An in-cluster request to the Service returns Git revision 475ea41; the rollout status is still progressing in this capture.

title: Green switch synchronized
caption: Argo CD shows the Green-routing Git revision 83eef67 as Healthy and Synced.

title: Rollback committed to Git
caption: The Service selector is changed back to taskops and pushed in rollback commit 6b01807.

title: Rollback synchronized
caption: Argo CD shows rollback revision 6b01807 as Healthy and Synced.

title: Blue response after rollback
caption: The Service again selects Blue. The in-cluster response identifies the current Blue image as 538fca7, which was updated during the exercise.

title: Final runtime and repository checks
caption: Both application environments and the database are running, Argo CD is Synced and Healthy, the supporting containers are listed and the Git history shows successive milestones.

title: Final documentation commit pushed
caption: Commit 10b0071 is pushed and the working tree is clean. The new documentation package is prepared against this source revision.
